## Reasons
- `robot_radius_m`: CAD circumradius 0.175 (dome wall) + 0.01 pad; a circle is exact for an omni robot
- `wheel_speed_cap_m_s`: wheel_steps_per_sec_max / (steps_per_rev / (2 pi r))
- `wheel_centre_radius_m`: CAD wheel-centre plane radius (the v13-era firmware had 0.151)
- `w_max_rad_s`: policy
- `v_max_m_s`: wheel_cap_fraction*cap - R_wheel*w_max: the fastest wheel runs at |v| + R*w along its drive direction
- `a_brake_m_s2`: brake_decel_fraction * min(firmware decel, usable accel)
- `a_acc_m_s2`: firmware ACCEL_XY
- `fw_decel_xy_m_s2`: firmware DECEL_XY (largest decel_lim a planner may assume)
- `a_brake_w_rad_s2`: policy * firmware
- `a_acc_w_rad_s2`: firmware ACCEL_W
- `scan_time_s`: 1 / slowest scan rate (points in one scan are up to this old)
- `latency_fixed_s`: gate 20 Hz period + bridge hop + firmware command period/loop
- `stop_distance_at_vmax_m`: v*t + v^2/(2a), t = fixed + scan_time + 0.05 s typical scan transport age
- `lateral_margin_m`: policy: extra half-width of the swept corridor
- `stop_margin_m`: policy
- `dyn_obstacle_speed_m_s`: policy
- `gap_needed_at_vmax_m`: free distance beyond the robot circle needed to run at v_max
- `lidar.blind_wedges_deg`: cap blade azimuths from CAD, half-width 2 deg >= 0.84 deg shadow + A1 beam width
- `nav.inflation_cost_scaling_factor`: ln2 / stop_distance: the cost falls to 50 % of lethal one stopping distance outside the robot circle -> 5.67
- `nav.inflation_radius`: robot radius + ~2 stopping distances (local) / + max(0.30, 2.5) stops (global); a 0.80 m door leaves 0.22 m of soft cost, not lethal
- `nav.sim_time`: (stopping distance + 2 robot radii) / v_max: DWB must look far enough to stop and to judge a gap; clamped to [1.5, 3] s
- `nav.samples`: trajectory count limited so ~25600 pose evaluations x 2.0 us stay inside 55 % of one control period (55 ms)
- `nav.amcl_update_min_d`: >= distance travelled per scan at v_max (0.030 m); finer only costs CPU
